row.answer: Once Crescent Guard is learned, his basic attacks and Audacious Charge can mark enemy champions as Challenged. On activation, it deals physical damage to nearby enemies based partly on their current health, knocking back and briefly stunning enemies that are not Challenged. Xin Zhao then temporarily blocks damage from enemy champions outside his circle, including their ongoing or delayed damage if they are outside when it applies.
row.counterplay: Save damage while outside his protective circle, and watch for him to separate allies from the Challenged target.
